name: supply-iptsc-shortfall
narrative: Ngozi runs supply for the programme's school malaria prevention round. The SCHI district store the round draws from is empty, and the 700 IPTSc packets she ordered from Harmattan Health Supplies are overdue. She opens the packet in the catalogue and confirms what the programme is counting: one packet holds a full three-day course, so 700 packets are 700 three-day courses. Musa at Harmattan opens the update link the programme gave him, with no labs login, and records the dispatch of the 450 packets he could find. Hauwa at the Sahel Community Health Initiative opens her own link and records the 450 packets that reached the SCHI district store. Ngozi opens the order and reads it: 700 ordered, 450 received, 250 still outstanding, and the order past its promised lead time. Hauwa's team has already bought the missing 250 from Tamarind Pharmacy Wholesale, a vendor they know, out of SCHI's setup fee, so Ngozi records that purchase as its own order, with SCHI as the buyer, paid as bundled, and marked as buying the shortfall on the Harmattan order. Its cost reads as bundled in the setup fee rather than as a missing price. When the 250 reach the store, Hauwa records them through SCHI's own link, which covers everything involving SCHI. Back on the Harmattan order, Ngozi sees the shortfall covered by name and the lateness gone. Back on the stock page, the store that held nothing reads 700 packets with nothing left overdue, and its balance opens onto Harmattan's 450 and Tamarind's 250: seven hundred courses, every one the round ordered.

hauwa.intro: Hauwa runs the IPTSc round in the schools and receives the packets into SCHI's district store; when the distributor ran short her team bought the rest locally.
hauwa.name: Hauwa Bello
hauwa.role: Programme manager, Sahel Community Health Initiative (local partner)

musa.intro: Musa sources and ships the programme's orders, and is usually asked by message what he sent and when.
musa.name: Musa Garba

ngozi.intro: Ngozi places the programme's orders and has to know, without chasing anyone on WhatsApp, whether the partner holds enough packets for every child on the list.
ngozi.name: Ngozi Adeyemi

features.description: Stock across the network lists, beside each store's balance, the orders still to arrive there (the order page's own Still outstanding), flags them overdue past their due date, and never counts them as cover.
features.verify: pytest connect_labs/supply_chain/tests/test_stock_page_honesty.py; Playwright: /supply/stock/ shows 'not counted as cover' beside the SCHI district store

scenes.narrative: Ngozi runs supply for the school malaria prevention round. On the stock page, the SCHI district store the round draws from holds nothing, and the 700 packets ordered from Harmattan Health Supplies sit beside it as expected, overdue, and not counted as cover. That one order is what she will follow, from the distributor's dispatch to the partner's shelf, instead of a thread of messages.
scenes.title: An empty store, and a school round waiting on one late order

features.description: Item.components and Item.one_course_is render on the item detail page as a contents table and a "one packet is one full course" statement.
features.verify: pytest connect_labs/supply_chain/tests/test_kits.py; Playwright: item page shows "is one full course" and a row "9 tablet"

scenes.narrative: Ngozi opens the packet in the catalogue. It lists what is inside — nine tablets and a dosing card — and says one packet is one full course, so she can count 700 packets as 700 three-day courses.
scenes.title: Ngozi checks that a packet is a whole course

features.description: The token-gated page /supply/u/<token>/ lets the linked organisation record a shipment against a contract in its scope, written with source=supplier_reported.
features.verify: pytest connect_labs/supply_chain/tests -k update_link; Playwright: after submitting Record a dispatch the page shows "Recorded:"

scenes.narrative: Musa opens the link the programme gave Harmattan, with no labs login. He picks the order, types the waybill and the carrier, and records that 450 packets left on the nineteenth, due at the store on the twenty-second.
scenes.title: Musa records the 450 packets he could find

features.description: The update link's Record goods received form writes a receipt at a supply point in the link's scope, bringing the accepted quantity into the ledger.
features.verify: Playwright: submit Record goods received on the partner link; supply_chain_stock_on_hand for the store returns 450 packet

scenes.narrative: Hauwa opens SCHI's own link when the truck reaches the district store. She picks the order and the store, and records 450 packets accepted.
scenes.title: Hauwa records 450 packets on the shelf

features.description: contract_delivery_overdue derives days late from signed_on + promised_lead_time_days while the contract is not fully received, shown as a banner on the order page.
features.verify: pytest connect_labs/supply_chain/tests/test_overdue.py; Playwright: order page shows "past the promised lead time"

features.description: contract_match returns ordered, received, invoiced and outstanding for the contract, rendered in the order page's match table.
features.verify: MCP supply_chain_contract_match(contract_id) returns outstanding.amount "250" after a 450-packet receipt

scenes.narrative: Ngozi opens the Harmattan order. It reads 700 ordered, 450 received and 250 still outstanding, and a banner says the order is past the lead time Harmattan promised.
scenes.title: Ngozi reads the order as 250 short and past due

features.description: The order form's "Paid for how" (consideration) and "Buys the shortfall on" (covers_shortfall_of) fields write Contract.consideration and Contract.covers_shortfall_of.
features.verify: pytest connect_labs/supply_chain/tests/test_small_gaps.py -k covering; MCP supply_chain_contract_get returns consideration=bundled and covers_shortfall_of_id

features.description: contract_landed_cost for a consideration=bundled contract returns {not_costed "bundled in setup fee"} and the order page shows the bundled badge and explanation.
features.verify: pytest connect_labs/supply_chain/tests/test_consideration.py; Playwright: order page shows "Bundled in setup fee"

scenes.narrative: Hauwa's team has already bought the missing 250 from Tamarind Pharmacy Wholesale, out of SCHI's setup fee. Ngozi records it as its own order, with SCHI as the buyer, paid as bundled, and marks it as buying the shortfall on the Harmattan order.
scenes.title: Ngozi records SCHI's local purchase as the cover

features.description: An update link issued as 'Everything involving this organisation' resolves its scope at each request, so an order the partner buys after the link was issued is offered for Record goods received, and only receipts are offered to an organisation that does not supply.
features.verify: pytest connect_labs/supply_chain/tests/test_update_links_follow_org.py; Playwright: SCHI link offers SCHI-LP-0921 in Record goods received

scenes.narrative: When Tamarind's 250 packets reach the district store, Hauwa records them through the same SCHI link. The link covers everything involving SCHI, so the new order is already on it; she picks it and records 250 packets accepted.
scenes.title: Hauwa records the 250 from Tamarind

features.description: three_way_match reports status shortfall_covered with covered_by naming the covering contract, and _contract_lateness is suppressed while covered_by is non-empty.

scenes.narrative: Back on the Harmattan order, Ngozi sees the 250 shortfall covered by SCHI's order from Tamarind, by name, and the lateness banner is gone.
scenes.title: The short order reads as covered, and no longer late

features.description: network_stock returns each supply point's ledger balance, rendered on /supply/stock/ per supply point.
features.verify: MCP supply_chain_stock_on_hand(supply_point_id=<store>) returns 700 packet after both receipts

scenes.narrative: Back on the stock page, the SCHI district store that held nothing now reads 700 packets, with no order left expected or overdue. She opens the balance: Harmattan's 450 and Tamarind's 250, seven hundred three-day courses, every one the round ordered.
scenes.title: The empty store now holds 700 courses
